map.算法（简化式）：eGFR = 175 × SCr^(-1.154) × 年龄^(: Algorithm (simplified): eGFR = 175 × SCr^(-1.154) × age^(-0.203) × (female ×0.742). Serum creatinine in mg/dL. SCr must be >0 and age >0.
map.例1（SCr 1.0 mg/dL、50 岁、男）：eGFR = 175×1.0^: Example 1 (SCr 1.0 mg/dL, age 50, male): eGFR = 175×1.0^(-1.154)×50^(-0.203) = 79.1 mL/min. Example 2 (SCr 1.5 mg/dL, age 65, female): eGFR = 175×1.5^(-1.154)×65^(-0.203)×0.742 = 34.9 mL/min (below 60, indicating reduced kidney function; a nephrology visit is advised).
map.和 egfr 那版有何不同？: How is it different from the egfr version?
map.本版用简化 175 式且血肌酐按 mg/dL；egfr 那版用完整 CKD-EP: This version uses the simplified 175 equation with serum creatinine in mg/dL, whereas the egfr version uses the full CKD-EPI with µmol/L. The formulas and units differ, so the numbers are not directly comparable; enter values in the unit shown on the page.
map.eGFR 低就一定是肾病吗？: Does a low eGFR always mean kidney disease?
map.不一定，脱水、感染、药物可一过性降低；慢性肾病定义为 eGFR<60 持续 ≥3: Not necessarily; dehydration, infection and drugs can lower it transiently. Chronic kidney disease is defined as eGFR <60 for ≥3 months, requiring re-testing and judgement together with urine protein.
